name: Semaglutide (Ozempic) for Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus — Molina NJ NJ-RX-SEMA-DM-2024

branches.initial: Initial prior authorization for semaglutide (Ozempic / Rybelsus) for type 2 diabetes mellitus

criteria.description: Medical necessity for semaglutide (Ozempic/Rybelsus) in type 2 diabetes mellitus: confirmed T2DM diagnosis AND age AND glycemic evidence (A1c ≥ 7.0% within 90 days) AND step therapy (metformin trial or contraindication AND inadequate response) AND T2DM-management indication.

policy_citation.quote: Authorization is approved when ALL of the following criteria are met

children.description: Confirmed diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus documented in the medical record.

policy_citation.quote: Confirmed diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus documented in the medical record

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for a Condition with ICD-10 in the E11.* family (E11.9 uncomplicated, E11.65 with hyperglycemia, E11.40 with neuropathy, or any other E11 subcode confirming T2DM).

verdict_rubric.met: Patient has a documented Condition with an ICD-10 code in the E11.* T2DM family.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Patient's diagnoses include only non-T2DM glycemic disorders (e.g., type 1, pre-diabetes R73.03 only).
verdict_rubric.unclear: Narrative mentions 'diabetes' without specifying type, or only A1c values without a coded diagnosis.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No diagnostic information available in records.

children.description: Patient is 18 years of age or older at the time of the prior-authorization request.

policy_citation.quote: Patient is 18 years of age or older

evaluation.extraction_hints: Compute age from Patient.birthDate at the request date.

verdict_rubric.met: Patient's age at the request date is ≥ 18 years.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Patient's age at the request date is < 18 years.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Patient.birthDate present but request date ambiguous.

children.description: Hemoglobin A1c value of 7.0% or greater documented within the prior 90 days.

policy_citation.quote: Hemoglobin A1c value of 7.0 percent or greater documented within the prior 90 days

evaluation.extraction_hints: Find an Observation or DiagnosticReport with LOINC 4548-4 (HbA1c) ≥ 7.0% measured within the 90 days immediately preceding the request date. Highest qualifying value within the window counts.

verdict_rubric.met: At least one HbA1c result ≥ 7.0% dated within 90 days of the request.
verdict_rubric.not_met: All HbA1c values within 90 days are < 7.0%.
verdict_rubric.unclear: HbA1c result present but date missing or outside the 90-day window; or A1c referenced only narratively without a numeric value.

children.description: Step therapy: documented metformin trial (≥3 months) or contraindication, AND inadequate glycemic response to metformin monotherapy at the maximum tolerated dose.
Documented metformin trial of at least 3 months, OR documented contraindication to metformin.

policy_citation.quote: Documented trial of metformin for a minimum of 3 months, unless contraindicated

children.description: Documented trial of metformin for a minimum of 3 months.

policy_citation.quote: Documented trial of metformin for a minimum of 3 months, unless contraindicated

evaluation.extraction_hints: Find a metformin prescription or medication statement with start/end dates spanning ≥3 months, OR a clinician note explicitly attesting to ≥3 months of metformin use.

verdict_rubric.met: Metformin documented for ≥3 months via dated medication records or explicit duration narrative.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Metformin listed without dates or duration; or stated 'on metformin' without timeframe.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No metformin prescription or use recorded.

children.description: Documented clinical contraindication to metformin (e.g., eGFR < 30, severe hepatic impairment, history of lactic acidosis, hypersensitivity).

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for explicit clinician statement of metformin contraindication. Strong signals: eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73m² Observation, severe hepatic dysfunction, prior lactic acidosis, AllergyIntolerance to metformin.

verdict_rubric.met: Clinician explicitly documents a contraindication to metformin for this patient.
verdict_rubric.not_met: No contraindication; metformin is expected per usual care.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Patient declined metformin for non-clinical reasons (cost, GI discomfort tolerated by most) without a clinical contraindication.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: Metformin tolerability or contraindication status not addressed.

children.description: Inadequate glycemic response to metformin monotherapy at the maximum tolerated dose.

policy_citation.quote: Inadequate glycemic response to metformin monotherapy at maximum tolerated dose

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for HbA1c remaining ≥ 7.0% (or specified target unmet) while on metformin monotherapy at max tolerated dose. Document max tolerated dose via current MedicationRequest dosage instructions. Inapplicable if the metformin-contraindication branch was satisfied — in that case, glycemic non-response is established by the qualifying A1c alone.

verdict_rubric.met: A1c ≥ 7.0% (or unmet target) documented while on metformin monotherapy at max tolerated dose; OR metformin contraindicated AND qualifying A1c documented.
verdict_rubric.not_met: A1c is at target on metformin monotherapy; semaglutide not yet indicated.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Metformin dose escalation not documented; or A1c on metformin not recorded.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: Response to metformin not addressed in records.

children.description: Medication is being prescribed for the management of type 2 diabetes mellitus, not for weight management as a primary indication.

policy_citation.quote: The medication is being prescribed for the management of type 2 diabetes mellitus, not for weight management as a primary indication

evaluation.extraction_hints: Check MedicationRequest.reasonCode/reasonReference and clinician note. Primary indication should be T2DM glycemic management (A1c reduction). Coexisting obesity is acceptable so long as weight management is not the stated primary purpose.

verdict_rubric.met: Prescribing note or MedicationRequest.reasonCode clearly indicates T2DM management as the primary indication.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Prescribing note explicitly cites weight loss / obesity management as the primary reason for semaglutide.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Both indications mentioned without primacy specified.

exclusions.description: Primary indication is weight management or obesity rather than glycemic control — route to the separate anti-obesity medication policy.

policy_citation.quote: The medication is being prescribed primarily for weight management or obesity rather than for glycemic control

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for obesity (E66.*) on the problem list combined with prescribing rationale that explicitly cites weight loss as the primary purpose. References to Wegovy-style dosing schedules or weight-loss targets are strong signals.

verdict_rubric.met: Documented primary indication is weight management / obesity (e.g., 'starting Ozempic for weight loss').
verdict_rubric.not_met: Primary indication is T2DM glycemic control; any weight-loss effect is secondary or unmentioned.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Both indications appear without explicit primacy.

exclusions.description: Patient has a diagnosis of type 1 diabetes mellitus (E10.*) — semaglutide is not indicated for T1DM.

policy_citation.quote: Patient has a diagnosis of type 1 diabetes mellitus (E10.*)

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for any Condition with ICD-10 in the E10.* family. T1DM is a categorical contraindication for this policy even if a T2DM code is also present (verify the primary diagnosis).

verdict_rubric.met: Active Condition with ICD-10 in E10.* family documented.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Narrative mentions 'insulin-dependent diabetes' without confirming type 1 vs insulin-requiring type 2.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: Diabetes type not specified in records.

exclusions.description: Personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (boxed-warning contraindication).

policy_citation.quote: Personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (contraindication)

evaluation.extraction_hints: Search the problem list and family history for medullary thyroid carcinoma (C73 with MTC modifier, or narrative 'medullary thyroid cancer') or Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia type 2 (MEN2, MEN2A, MEN2B, ICD-10 E31.22 / E31.23). Both personal and family history qualify.

verdict_rubric.met: Documented personal or family history of MTC or MEN2.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Family / personal history reviewed and is negative for MTC and MEN2.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Thyroid nodule or unspecified thyroid cancer mentioned without specifying medullary subtype.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: Family and personal endocrine history not addressed in records.

metadata.notes: Models Molina NJ Clinical Policy NJ-RX-SEMA-DM-2024 (Semaglutide / Ozempic / Rybelsus for Type 2 Diabetes). Sibling to molina-nj-semaglutide-obesity — same payer/state/HCPCS, separated by ICD-10 indication. Selector relies on Claim.item[0].diagnosisSequence to route between the two.
